song.author: Jack Hayford
song.title: Majesty, Worship His Majesty
song.lyrics:
[V1] .G C Majesty, worship His Majesty; . G Em Am7 D7 Unto Jesus be all glory, honor, and praise; .G C Am G Majesty, kingdom authority flow from His throne . D7 G Unto His own, His anthem raise!
[V2] . Am7 D7 G So exalt, lift up on high the name of Jesus; . Am7 D7 B7 Am7D7 Magnify, come glorify Christ Jesus the King; .G C Am Majesty, worship His Majesty . G D7 Jesus who died, now glorified, . G King of all kings.
